## Design

### 2026-10-28: Downloaded all the resources I needed for the project and did a bit of researching with AI. Could not find the footprints and symbols for a lot of the materials and could not figure how to make it and

**2h**

Downloaded all the resources I needed for the project and did a bit of researching with AI. Could not find the footprints and symbols for a lot of the materials and could not figure how to make it and be cost efficient so I set AI to make the footprints. I selected the Rasberry Pi Pico 2 for the microcontroller and decided on a 2.8" 240×320 SPI TFT with touch (ILI9341 + XPT2046) for the screen.

### 2026-10-29: Worked on the basics of the schematic and put in the pico and screen. Also wired the TFT and the screen with the power connecters to the main microcontroller. Going to work and finish soon. Capacitors

**1.7h**

Worked on the basics of the schematic and put in the pico and screen. Also wired the TFT and the screen with the power connecters to the main microcontroller. Going to work and finish soon. Capacitors are soon to be wired.
